status: LOCKED before any outcome computation; script and results follow in later commits
finding_under_test: Published-catalog comparator (results/catalog_comparator.json, c01f963/4c3dad1): 9/10 in-corpus catalog antigens are clinically 'genuine' vs 11/195 outside the catalog, Fisher one-sided p=1.1e-9, OR=150.5.
weakness: Catalog antigens are heavily studied, and the 'genuine' verdict derives from ClinicalTrials.gov activity, which plausibly scales with how well studied a gene is. The enrichment may partly reflect annotation depth rather than anything the catalog adds. Lane A's own annotation-bias program (#2/#3) shows the corpus is over-annotated on literature metrics.
question: Does catalog membership still predict a 'genuine' verdict among corpus genes of comparable annotation depth?
data: results/clintrials_per_gene.csv (verdict) joined to results/pharos_per_gene.csv (publication_count, generif_count) on gene, 205 corpus genes; catalog membership = the 10 in-corpus catalog genes from catalog_comparator.json. Genes with missing/non-ok Pharos status (3) are excluded and listed in the output.

design.strata: quintiles of log1p(publication_count) over the retained genes (pandas qcut, duplicates dropped)
design.statistic: number of catalog genes with verdict == 'genuine' (observed 9 before any stratification; recomputed on retained genes)
design.null: within each stratum, permute the catalog label among genes; 20000 permutations; seed 20261007; one-sided empirical p = (1+#null>=obs)/(1+20000)
secondary_descriptive: Mantel-Haenszel common OR with continuity-free zero-cell handling reported as 'undefined' when any margin is zero
same permutation test stratified instead on log1p(generif_count) quintiles

gates_locked.SURVIVES: stratified permutation p < 0.05 on publication_count strata

rules: No change to strata, test, seed, or gates after outcomes are seen.
No variant strata sweeps; generif strata are a pre-declared secondary, not a rescue.
All outcomes reported as measured; free CPU only; PREREG gates and existing stats files untouched.
limitations_declared: Adjustment is for annotation depth only; other confounders (cancer type, antigen age) are not modeled. 10 catalog genes limit power; a null result would mean unresolved, not refuted. The catalog is a single review (PMC12374352).
